subject: Post-call: protected data hosting paths and next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Chen <lauren@medovia.com>, Michael Ross <m.ross@medovia.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: protected data hosting paths and next steps

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery call and clear next steps so we're all aligned.

Call summary
- Use case: Medovia wants to surface patient-facing summaries derived from clinical notes. Outputs may include PHI (names, MRNs, timestamps).
- Primary asks: confirmation that Redwood can support PHI under a BAA, final list of eligible hosting modes, and copies of SOC 2 evidence and our typical BAA.

High-level PHI handling boundaries (initial guidance)
- Dedicated and Private deployments: supported for PHI under a signed Business Associate Agreement (BAA). These provide compute tenancy and network isolation.
- Hosted API: generally for non-PHI or pseudonymized data. We can discuss limited exceptions but recommend Dedicated or Private for full-PHI workflows.

Immediate next steps (for our side)
1) Medovia to send vendor security questionnaire (if not already attached).
2) Redwood to share SOC 2 Type II summary and a draft BAA for review.
3) Technical follow-up: we’ll confirm whether specific pseudonymization/PII redaction flow would allow Hosted API for your workload.

Could you please attach the vendor questionnaire and your target timeline for a contract? I’ll loop in our security and infra colleagues once we have the doc.

Attachments: Medovia_Call_Notes_20271122.txt (summary)

Thanks,
Ben

Subject: Re: Fwd: Medovia VSA + timeline — quick assessment request

Thanks for the ping, Ben — summary and recommended path below. I’ve attached the SOC 2 summary and a draft BAA tailored to Medovia's timeline.

Short answers
- SOC 2: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report / AOC. See attached (redwood-soc2-202706.pdf) and the secure link below.
- BAA: Redwood will execute a Business Associate Agreement. Standard practice: BAAs are available for Dedicated and Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments; for Hosted API we assess on a case-by-case basis and generally recommend Dedicated/Private for any workload that stores PHI. For Medovia's use case (persistent storage of PHI in outputs) we recommend Dedicated or Private.

Deployment eligibility (detailed)
- Dedicated (recommended): Reserved capacity with tenant isolation. Full BAA support. US-region tenancy can be guaranteed per contract. Best fit for production PHI workloads — predictable performance and standard SLOs.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): Full BAA support. Customer-managed network controls, KMS/HSM integration available. Strongest isolation for regulated workloads.
- Hosted (public API): Not recommended for persistent PHI storage. We may accommodate limited workflows where data is pseudonymized or where outputs are ephemeral and no PHI is retained; any Hosted use with PHI requires legal risk review and may impose additional controls.

Controls and mitigations we recommend if Medovia explores Hosted for low-PHI flows
- Token-level redaction prior to send (client-side)
- Prefix caching disabled for that tenant
- Strict retention policies and audit logging enabled

Attachments and links
- Attached: redwood-soc2-202706.pdf (redacted SOC 2 Type II), baa-draft-medovia-20271123.docx (BAA draft)
- Secure SOC 2 link: https://secure.redwood.ai/soc2/2027-type2
- Draft BAA has two optional clauses for deployment choice and key management — we'll iterate with your counsel.

Next steps for the week
1) Medovia: confirm target deployment (Dedicated vs Private) and any required KMS/HSM specifics.
2) Medovia: return the completed vendor security questionnaire (attached) by Nov 29 to stay on target for Dec 8 procurement.
3) Redwood (security + legal): review Medovia's VSA answers, finalize the draft BAA, and provide the SOC 2 AOC link to procurement.
4) Schedule a short technical call (30 min) between Medovia infra and our infra team to confirm networking and residency — propose Nov 26 at 11am PT.

If we confirm Dedicated or Private, we can get a contract-ready BAA in ~5 business days after questionnaire answers.

Regards,
